propositions: CLI verb `rebar attach-commits <ticket> <sha>...` exposes retroactive commit linking, validating all SHAs via git before recording a COMMITS event (all-or-nothing).
Shared DET module hoists `**/`-aware glob matching from prompts.py and registry.py into commit_impact.py to avoid rebar.llm imports; both former copies delegate to it.

Close precheck discovers commits from both COMMITS events and referencing-commit scan, unions their file_impact across ticket+descendants, and blocks close if any commit path is undeclared and unexempted.
Merge commits are explicitly skipped in close check; source-(i) SHAs are skipped on git errors, source-(ii) commits fail closed.
MCP registers attach_commits tool with outputSchema per existing write-tool pattern; CLI dispatch added to _ARGV_REGISTRY with pinned help.
Blocked close names offending paths and directs user to `rebar set-file-impact` remedy or `--force`.
